proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend (connect/accept handshake redesign, ECE negotiation, FLID/GID routing, traffic-class handling, receive/send readiness semantics, and per-device MR cache for registration reuse), which is squarely network transport/proxy behavior. Added gin because there are independently substantive GIN-path changes (GIN IB connect/accept integration, listener/connection cancellation cleanup, and GIN host/listen lifecycle updates) beyond incidental caller edits.
